title: Don't Fight Alone
devotional: Some battles become harder when you keep everything hidden. God created us for relationship, encouragement, correction, and support. You do not have to pretend that you have everything under control. The right person can help you see what you cannot see by yourself, encourage you when you are tired, and remind you of the truth when you are discouraged. This does not mean telling everyone everything. It means choosing wisely and refusing to isolate yourself when you need godly support.
mind_check: When you are struggling, do you usually reach out for healthy support or isolate yourself?
body_move: Take one practical step toward healthy connection today. Call, visit, or spend time with someone who encourages you to make good choices.
spirit_move: Ask God to show you one trustworthy person who can encourage you in your walk with Him. Pray for wisdom about what you should share and who you should trust.
way_out: When I feel isolated or overwhelmed, instead of hiding, I will reach out to __________.
prayer: Father, thank You for reminding me that I was not created to walk alone. Give me wisdom to recognize trustworthy people and humility to receive help when I need it. Protect me from isolation and surround me with people who encourage me to follow You. Help me also become someone who strengthens others. Amen.
action: Think of one trustworthy person who encourages your faith and your growth. Reach out to them today and let them know you appreciate their support.
